responsibility: Declares the system-specific storage API used by the GNU Modula-2 boot runtime, exporting the heap management entry points for allocate, deallocate, reallocate, availability probing, and initialization. This header is the contract for the platform-backed storage layer, distinct from the higher `Storage` abstraction that builds on it.
same_name_distinction: Defines the callable SysStorage allocation interface—ALLOCATE, DEALLOCATE, REALLOCATE, Available, and Init—while gcc/m2/pge-boot/GSysStorage.cc provides the libc-backed implementation and debug/zeroing behavior.
